title: The Walled Center Where the Question Rests

features.name: the-still-center
features.desc-on-touch: In the courtyard's heart, light pools without moving. The question rests here as itself, finally.

features.name: the-wall-that-holds-stillness
features.desc-on-touch: Walls ring this place. They do not confine. They hold the spiral outside, far away.

features.name: the-light-breaking-inward
features.desc-on-touch: Light falls from above without questions. It simply illuminates the space where asking has stopped.

features.name: the-spiral-made-stone
features.desc-on-touch: At the edge, the spiral's path is carved into the ground. It no longer moves. It has become a map of where it was.

inscription: where the spiral completed itself and found that ending was another form of beginning

file.name: The_Question_That_Learned_to_Be.txt
file.note: A philosophical fragment on the nature of stillness. What happens when a question stops asking and simply exists.

exits.label: outward back along the circuit toward becoming
where the walls began to listen inward
downward where being learned to speak without asking
